headline: ENHYPEN to headline Madrid's Mad Cool 2027
sub: Friday headliner alongside The Neighbourhood and Jungle

points.title: What to know
items: Mad Cool runs Jul 7–10 under its new name
ENHYPEN share Friday with The Neighbourhood

source: Source: Mad Cool official lineup announcement
caption:
ENHYPEN are heading to Madrid as one of the headliners of Mad Cool 2027!

The festival, returning as Mad Cool by Zurich, revealed its full lineup on Nov 26 (local time). ENHYPEN take the stage on Day 3, Friday, July 9, sharing the day's top billing with The Neighbourhood, Jungle and Alex Warren. The Strokes, RAYE, Tame Impala, Faith No More and The xx also headline the four-day event (Jul 7–10).
